postings.title: Accountant (UAE nationals only)
postings.description:
Job title: ACCOUNTANT (UAE nationals only)
Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
Job reference #: 34001
Contract type: 10-year fixed-term contract. Please note that this position is part of the Emiratisation Programme; only UAE nationals who hold a Family Book will be considered.
Language requirements: Arabic. Intermediate level of English.

At Eni, we are looking for an Accountant to join Eni Abu Dhabi.

About Eni Abu Dhabi B.V.

Eni Abu Dhabi B.V. is a subsidiary of Eni, a global energy company active in the exploration, development, and production of hydrocarbons and natural gas, as well as refining and chemicals activities in the United Arab Emirates. With a robust partnership with ADNOC, Eni Abu Dhabi B.V. is committed to ensuring a stable and affordable gas supply for the country, contributing to its self-sufficiency and status as a gas exporter. Eni Abu Dhabi is also a multicultural organization that brings together professionals from 17 diverse nationalities, reflecting the Eni’s commitment to fostering integration and inclusion as core principals of its corporate culture. Our employees thrive within a forward-thinking organization that emphasizes innovation, sustainability, and professional growth, underpinned by our commitment to achieving carbon neutrality by 2050. Through strategic agreements in exploration and production, refining and chemicals, our presence in the UAE continues to expand, driven by the scale and impact of the Ruwais and Ghasha projects, alongside our strong partnership with ADNOC. The Ruwais refinery, the fourth largest globally in terms of production capacity, enhances our high competitiveness in crude oil processing.

Main responsibilities

- Process vendor invoices accurately and in a timely manner using SAP.
- Perform three-way matching of purchase orders, goods receipts, and supplier invoices.
- Verify invoice accuracy and obtain the necessary approvals prior to payment.
- Prepare and process vendor payments through various payment methods.
- Reconcile vendor statements and promptly resolve discrepancies.
- Monitor ageing reports and follow up on outstanding invoices and debit/credit notes.
- Coordinate with procurement, receiving, and business departments to resolve invoice-related issues.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and tax regulations.
- Support month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals and reconciliations.
- Assist with internal and external audits by providing the required documentation.
- Identify opportunities to improve accounts payable processes and efficiency.
- Prepare reports and analyses related to accounts payable as required by management.

Skills and experience required

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
- Knowledge of accounting principles and financial statements.
- Experience with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle).
- Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality.
- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.
- Strong problem-solving and process-improvement skills.
- Excellent communication skills, with strong written and verbal English proficiency.
- Strong planning, organisational, and time-management skills.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

How to apply

- Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
- Please upload your CV in English.

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.

Working at Eni

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

postings.description:
Wer wir sind

Wir verantworten den Vertrieb eines umfangreichen Produktportfolios an Hochleistungs­schmierstoffen, Additi­ven und Fetten in allen Anwendungsbereichen von Automotive und Industrie.

Bei sämtlichen Geschäftsaktivitäten von Enilive Schmiertechnik steht eine qualitativ hochwertige Leis­tungs­erbringung sowie eine nachhaltige und zukunftsorientierte Entwicklung im Fokus. Ziel und Ver­pflichtung für uns ist es, langfristigen wirtschaftlichen Erfolg mit dem Schutz der Umwelt und der Über­nahme gesellschaft­licher Verantwortung zu verknüpfen.

Enilive Schmiertechnik verfügt über ein regelmäßig auditiertes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsmanage­mentsystem und erfüllt damit die Forderungen der Normen ISO 9001:2015 „Qualitätsmanagement“, ISO 45001:2018 „Ar­beitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz“ sowie ISO 14001:2015 „Umweltmanage­ment“ für den Geltungsbe­reich Herstellung und Vertrieb von Automotiv- und Industrieschmierstoffen, Metallbearbeitungsflüssigkei­ten, Kraftstoff- und Heizöladditiven sowie Serviceprodukten für den Werkstattbereich.

Was Sie mitbringen sollten:

At Eni, we are looking for an Asset Manager to join Eni Plenitude Renewables France.

Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. - Proficiency in French (native or C2).

postings.description:
Job Title: Asset Manager
Location: Houston, TX, USA
Job Reference #: 33169
Employment Type: Permanent. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States to be considered for this position.
Language Requirements: English (C2 proficiency or equivalent)

At Eni, we are seeking an Asset Manager to join Plenitude Renewable US in Houston.

You will be responsible for overseeing the commercial, contractual, and administrative aspects of Plenitude Renewable US's operational renewable energy assets across the United States. In this role, you will support the day-to-day management of renewable energy projects by monitoring asset performance, ensuring compliance with O&M contract terms and conditions, and coordinating commercial and administrative activities to help achieve production, availability, and performance targets.

About Plenitude

Plenitude Renewables US Inc. is a leading renewable energy company and part of Plenitude, Eni's integrated energy transition business. Based in Houston, Texas, the company develops, owns, and operates utility-scale renewable energy and energy storage assets across the United States, with a focus on solar, wind, and battery storage projects. Through innovation, strategic partnerships, and a commitment to sustainability, Plenitude Renewables US contributes to the growth of clean energy infrastructure while supporting the transition to a lower-carbon energy future. As part of a global organization operating in more than 15 countries, the company offers employees the opportunity to work on impactful projects that help shape the future of energy

Detailed Responsibilities

Asset Performance & Operational Oversight

- Oversee monthly energy production and key operational KPIs, analyzing and reporting variances versus budget and forecast.
- Support the Operations department in monitoring plant performance, including energy production, availability, PR, curtailment, and defects, proactively identifying and flagging potential underperformance.
- Review and discuss performance loss analyses (e.g., curtailment, outages, and defects) with the Operations team and O&M contractors, contributing to the definition and tracking of corrective action plans.
- Participate in site visits, inspections, and technical audits, as required, to support asset performance, availability, and integrity.

Contract & Commercial Management

- Ensure compliance with O&M contract terms and conditions, including performance requirements, service-level requirements, and reporting obligations.
- Support the negotiation, renewal, and amendment of operational and new service contracts and RFPs, in coordination with the Procurement and Legal departments.
- Oversee the management of land lease agreements, including monitoring contractual obligations, tracking key milestones and deadlines, and ensuring ongoing compliance with lease terms.
- Assist in the management of joint-venture assets and relationships with project partners, ensuring alignment with contractual agreements and governance frameworks.
- Assist in the resolution of commercial and contractual disputes.

Financial & Budget Monitoring

- Support Cost Analyst functions in monitoring OPEX and major cost drivers at the asset level, supporting budget adherence and providing input on operational cost variances in coordination with Finance.
- Support internal reporting on asset-level financial and operational performance, including inputs to budget reviews and forecasts, where required.

HSE & Regulatory Compliance

- Contribute to HSE and compliance initiatives, ensuring adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, laws, and Eni Group policies and standards.
- Support the maintenance of asset integrity and the implementation of corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, or regulatory findings.

Stakeholder Coordination

- Act as the primary point of contact for financing parties, including lenders and tax equity partners, supporting ongoing operational and financial reporting obligations.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external parties to ensure the timely, accurate, and consistent flow of information across the asset portfolio.

Skills and experience required

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or Renewable Energy Engineering preferred.
- Degrees in Economics, Finance, or Business Administration will also be considered with relevant renewable energy asset management experience and strong technical understanding.

Experience & Qualifications

- Significant experience in asset management, operations, or maintenance within the solar, wind, and/or BESS sectors, preferably supporting utility-scale renewable energy assets.
- Experience managing operational and commercial budgets.
- Experience managing contracts and resolving commercial disputes.
- Strong understanding of corporate processes, governance frameworks, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and/or CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics 365).
- Fluent in English.

Soft Skills

- Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with a commitment to continuous improvement.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-management abilities.
- Collaborative mindset with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Adaptable and solutions-focused, with a professional approach to managing complex challenges.

Authorization

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for any employer. The Company will not sponsor employment visas for this position, now or in the future.

How to apply

- Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
- Please upload your CV in English.

postings.title: BUSINESS DEVELOPER EXPERT
postings.description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPER EXPERT

Come Business Developer Expert farai parte di Evogy. In particolare, il tuo team è responsabile dello sviluppo del business e della crescita commerciale, supportando clienti B2B nel percorso di digitalizzazione e ottimizzazione dei consumi energetici. L’attività del team comprende la mappatura del mercato, l’individuazione di nuove opportunità e la gestione dell’intero ciclo di vendita, dalla fase di contatto fino alla chiusura dei contratti. Il team opera con un approccio consulenziale, lavorando a stretto contatto con i clienti per comprendere le loro esigenze energetiche e proporre soluzioni tecnologiche personalizzate. Questo avviene sia attraverso la collaborazione con le funzioni tecniche e di prodotto interne, sia grazie a una rete di partner strategici, con l'obiettivo di fornire un supporto a 360 gradi al cliente.

Attività principali:

- Identificazione nuove opportunità e lead generation (B2B)

- Gestione end-to-end del ciclo di vendita

- Consulenza commerciale su soluzioni energetiche e digitali

- Sviluppo networking e presenza a eventi di settore

- Collaborazione con team tecnico e product

- Analisi mercato e segmentazione clienti target

- Gestione pipeline e trattative commerciali

- Raccolta requisiti cliente e definizione proposta di valore

- Posizionamento e promozione dei servizi aziendali

- Coordinamento interno per sviluppo offerte

- Monitoraggio performance commerciale

Caratteristiche richieste:

- Laurea magistrale in discipline STEM. Potranno essere presi in considerazione titoli di studio differenti, anche inferiori, a valle di significativa esperienza nell’ambito

- Esperienza di almeno 3 anni maturata in ruoli analoghi

- Conoscenza EMS e analisi dati energetici

- Conoscenza BMS e logiche di regolazione

- Conoscenza CRM (preferibilmente HubSpot)

- Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese

- Contratto di lavoro a Tempo Indeterminato

Sede:
Seriate (BG)

Promuoviamo forme flessibili di lavoro, offrendo opzioni di Smart working ed orari flessibili al fine di sostenere il maggior equilibrio tra vita professionale e personale.

Proponiamo:

- Il nostro contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro di riferimento è il CCNL Terziario

- Proponiamo una retribuzione annua lorda compresa tra 45000€ e 55000€

- L’offerta finale sarà formulata in coerenza con l’esperienza professionale, le competenze tecniche e trasversali possedute dalla risorsa funzionali per il ruolo e apprezzabili per l’azienda

- L’Azienda in presenza di esperienze professionali e competenze tecniche e trasversali particolarmente rilevanti potrà valutare un’offerta con un livello di inquadramento/RAL migliorativo

- Sistema di reward e programma articolato di benefits e iniziative di welfare in ambito sanitario, previdenziale, di supporto al reddito e per la conciliazione vita-lavoro.

- Ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni risorsa possa sentirsi riconosciuta e apprezzata nella propria unicità

Le candidature ritenute di maggior interesse saranno contattate per le fasi successive.

Per informazioni sul processo di selezione e consigli utili puoi cliccare qui.

Chi Siamo

Entrerai a far parte di Evogy, Società Benefit controllata da Plenitude, che sviluppa software, tecnologie IoT e algoritmi di intelligenza artificiale per la gestione intelligente dell’energia in edifici, impianti e distretti energetici complessi. Con sede a Seriate, operiamo al fianco di clienti commerciali, industriali e del terziario che vogliono migliorare l’efficienza energetica, valorizzare la flessibilità dei propri impianti e contribuire alla transizione energetica. Evogy riunisce competenze specialistiche nei campi dell’energia, dello sviluppo software, dell’analisi dei dati e dell’intelligenza artificiale. Come Società Benefit, persegue obiettivi di sostenibilità generando valore attraverso modelli di gestione dell’energia efficienti, digitali e orientati all’innovazione.

Plenitude Società Benefit opera in oltre 15 Paesi nel mondo con un modello di business integrato che unisce la produzione di energia elettrica da fonti rinnovabili, la vendita di energia e di soluzioni energetiche per i clienti e un’ampia rete di punti di ricarica per veicoli elettrici. Entro il 2030, la Società punta a raggiungere 15 GW di capacità rinnovabile installata a livello globale e 15 milioni di clienti.

Contract type: Fixed-term
Language requirements: English (advanced)

At Eni, we are seeking a Business Development Officer to join Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd. in Nairobi. You will be responsible for driving growth by identifying new business opportunities, managing client relationships and supporting the organisation's commercial objectives. This role requires a proactive professional who can research market trends, forge strategic partnerships and ensure that clients consistently receive tailored, high-value solution.

About Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd

Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd is an energy company committed to supporting a just energy transition through agricultural development, with the aim of preserving our planet and promoting efficient and sustainable access to energy for all. Our work is driven by passion and innovation, built on our unique strengths and expertise, and founded on respect for the equal dignity of every individual. We recognise diversity as a key value for human development and uphold responsibility, integrity and transparency in all our actions.

We focus on the development of sustainable oilseed crops, including castor beans cultivated on degraded land, croton trees grown within agroforestry systems, and other agro-industrial by-products such as cottonseed. The project also includes the construction of agro-processing facilities known as Agri-Hubs, where oil is extracted from non-edible oilseeds and used as feedstock for biorefineries producing biofuels. These Agri-Hubs generate income, improve market access, and serve as centres for training and technical support. They promote sustainable agriculture, soil regeneration, food security, and Kenya's decarbonisation efforts.

Main responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management

- Maintain and nurture relationships with Eni's clients, continuously assessing and responding to their evolving requirements.
- Consult with existing and prospective clients to provide products and solutions tailored to their specific needs.
- Serve as a key point of contact for client support throughout the duration of each engagement with the company.

Market Intelligence & Business Growth

- Continuously monitor markets and industry trends through research, networking, and regional benchmarking to identify opportunities and support business growth.
- Identify and evaluate new business opportunities across the organisation.
- Assess the evolving commercial landscape and analyse potential competitors within the company’s sector.

Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

- Arrange and facilitate meetings with key decision-makers in target organisations to establish and strengthen strategic partnerships.
- Establish, manage, and maintain effective communication channels with all stakeholders.

Strategy & Leadership

- Provide leadership in establishing a B2B function by designing and executing an effective strategy to support commercial growth objectives.
- Oversee the execution of the organisation’s strategic and annual business plans.
- Promote a culture that reflects the organisation’s values and commercial vision.

Skills and experience required:

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.
- A postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline would be an advantage.

Experience

- Relevant experience in business development, sales, or a related commercial role.
- Demonstrated track record of managing client relationships and delivering business growth.
- Experience in the energy, oil and gas, or a related sector is highly desirable.

Key Competencies

- Business acumen and commercial awareness.
- Strategic thinking and market analysis.
- Client relationship management.
- Negotiation and stakeholder engagement.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Research and analytical skills.
- Cross-functional collaboration.
- Self-motivated, proactive, and able to demonstrate initiative and leadership.

Chez Eni, nous recherchons un(e) CEE Control & Back Office Specialist pour rejoindre Eni Plenitude France. At this position, you will be responsible for processing and reviewing cases, both in B2C and B2B.. At this position, you will be responsible for processing and reviewing cases, both in B2C and B2B.

À propos de Plenitude

Plenitude est une entreprise énergétique qui intègre les activités de vente au détail et de production d’énergies renouvelables, avec des solutions d’autoconsommation et de mobilité électrique. Elle fournit de l’électricité et du gaz à plus de 10 millions de foyers et d’entreprises en Europe, offrant ainsi de nombreuses opportunités professionnelles enrichissantes pour l’ensemble des équipes.
Ce partenariat représente un projet européen majeur, combinant les activités liées aux énergies renouvelables et celles du retail. postings.title: External Relations Officer (Bonje Agrihub)
postings.description:
Job title: EXTERNAL RELATIONS OFFICER (BONJE AGRIHUB)
Location: Kwale, Kenya
Job reference #: 33692
Contract type: Fixed-term
Language requirements: English (advanced); Kiswahili (advanced)

At Eni, we are seeking an External Relations Officer (Bonje Agrihub) to join Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd. (ENEK) in Kwale. Reporting to the External Relations Manager, you will provide essential support in stakeholder engagement with governmental authorities, ministries, national and county governments, and community members, as well as in public information, data management, and administrative coordination. You will contribute to the effective implementation of ENEK’s projects and initiatives while ensuring alignment with company policies, industry standards, and local regulations.

About Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd

Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd is an energy company committed to supporting a just energy transition through agricultural development, with the aim of preserving our planet and promoting efficient and sustainable access to energy for all. Our work is driven by passion and innovation, built on our unique strengths and expertise, and founded on respect for the equal dignity of every individual. We recognise diversity as a key value for human development and uphold responsibility, integrity and transparency in all our actions.

We focus on the development of sustainable oilseed crops, including castor beans cultivated on degraded land, croton trees grown within agroforestry systems, and other agro-industrial by-products such as cottonseed. The project also includes the construction of agro-processing facilities known as Agri-Hubs, where oil is extracted from non-edible oilseeds and used as feedstock for biorefineries producing biofuels. These Agri-Hubs generate income, improve market access, and serve as centres for training and technical support. They promote sustainable agriculture, soil regeneration, food security, and Kenya's decarbonisation efforts.

Main responsibilities:

- Ensure ENEK maintains strong relationships with all relevant stakeholders and complies with applicable regulations.
- Support stakeholder engagement activities by scheduling meetings, preparing materials, and maintaining communication logs with key stakeholders, including communities, government agencies, and NGOs.
- Assist in engaging with external stakeholders and providing accurate information through the organisation of regular briefings and bilateral meetings.
- Collaborate with local communities to support the efficient and timely implementation of ENEK’s projects and initiatives.
- Act as the focal point for partner relations and community liaison activities related to ENEK’s projects and engagements with local communities.
- Assist in the implementation and monitoring of stakeholder communications by collecting and organising relevant data, maintaining records, and supporting reporting processes.
- Prepare reports and presentations by compiling information, drafting summaries, and ensuring document accuracy.
- Assist in organising training sessions, including managing logistics, invitations, and follow-up communications.
- Maintain and update databases related to the External Relations Department, ensuring the timely tracking of activities and outcomes.
- Stay abreast of current affairs and gather relevant information and updates from public authorities that may affect ENEK’s business and projects.
- Assist in planning and implementing communication strategies that promote support for ENEK’s operations among external stakeholders.

Skills and experience required:

- Bachelor's degree in Social Sciences, International Relations, Communications, or a related discipline.
- Relevant experience in communications, external relations, community development, stakeholder engagement, or administrative coordination.
- Experience in preparing and delivering reports and presentations.
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively across diverse cultures and stakeholder groups.
- Experience working across diverse teams, with the flexibility and adaptability to adjust to changing priorities and environments.
- Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

How to apply:

- Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
- Please upload your CV in English.

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.

Working at Eni

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

Energy for action takers

postings.title: Flow Assurance Technology Expert
postings.description:
Job title: FLOW ASSURANCE TECHNOLOGY EXPERT
Location: London, UK
Job reference #: 33907
Contract type: Permanent
Language requirements: Proficient in English

We are looking for a Flow Assurance Technology Expert to join Liverpool Bay CCS in London. You will be responsible for developing and optimising CO₂ transportation and injection strategies across the carbon capture and storage (CCS) value chain, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable flow from processing facilities to the reservoir. You will provide flow assurance expertise to support project development and operations, contribute to the definition of CCS network requirements, resolve issues related to fluid behaviour, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimise injectivity, support project delivery, and manage interfaces across key project work packages.

About Liverpool Bay CCS Limited

Liverpool Bay CCS Limited, a member of the Eni S.p.A. group, is the owner and operator of the Liverpool Bay Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Transportation and Storage (T&S) infrastructure. This project is a key component of the HyNet North West Industrial Cluster, aimed at reducing carbon emissions in the North West of England and North Wales. Liverpool Bay CCS Ltd works with hard-to-abate industries in the North West of England and North Wales, to transport captured CO₂ from various plants to safe and permanent storage beneath Liverpool Bay. The company is repurposing some of its existing infrastructure, including depleted reservoirs that have held natural gas for millions of years, to support economic growth in the region and help the UK achieve its Net Zero objectives. By joining Liverpool Bay CCS Ltd, employees become part of a pioneering effort in carbon capture and storage, contributing to a sustainable future while benefiting from a dynamic and innovative work environment.

Main responsibilities

- Ensure the flow assurance basis of design for CO₂ projects.
- Provide technical support, advice, and solutions throughout the different stages of projects, where flow conditions may transition from free flow to compression.
- Review detailed designs and technical documentation provided by work package managers.
- Develop and integrate commissioning, start-up, and operational procedures across multiple work packages.
- Interface with emitters to support network expansion activities from a flow assurance perspective.
- Provide transportation support for gas flow and dense-phase CO₂ operations.
- Provide technical support for pipeline utilisation for CO₂ transportation, downhole valves, and the control of the Joule-Thomson effect across the system, from the reservoir to surface facilities.
- Support the definition of the most efficient CO₂ transportation strategy, optimising pressures and flow rates from onshore to offshore facilities.
- Promote environmental standards and ensure compliance with company requirements, offshore chemical regulations, and OSPAR guidelines.
- Provide technical support on chemical management, including the evaluation of chemical solutions to enhance injectivity, optimise utility systems, and protect plant and equipment. Assess products from both technical and commercial perspectives, and evaluate their effectiveness and utilisation.
- Support injection metering activities and assist with allocation-related issues.
- Conduct site visits to project locations and provide support on operational matters.
- Participate in risk assessments relating to process operations and CO₂ injection activities.
- Ensure compliance with the Company's Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) policies, procedures, and standards.
- Fully comply with the Company's Code of Ethics and Compliance Model.
- Comply with the HSE Critical Roles Procedure where applicable to the position.

Skills and experience required

- Degree or postgraduate qualification in Engineering.
- Significant experience in the oil and gas industry in a production or engineering role.
- Experience managing engineering activities; flow assurance and process modelling experience would be advantageous.
- Strong analytical mindset with a logical and methodical approach.
- Self-motivated team player with strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent verbal, written, listening, and influencing skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise competing projects effectively.

How to apply

- Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
- Please upload your CV in English.

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. postings.description:
Job title: INDUSTRIAL RESIDUES COORDINATOR
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia
Job reference #: 33874
Contract type: Fixed-term
Language requirements: Fluent in Indonesian and English

At Eni, we are looking for an Industrial Residues Coordinator to join PT Eni Natural Energies Indonesia in Jakarta. You will be responsible for coordinating the sourcing and collection of used cooking oil (UCO), Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME) oil, and other residues used as bio-feedstocks.

About PT Eni Natural Energies Indonesia

PT Eni Natural Energies Indonesia (ENE Indonesia), part of the Eni Group, focuses on sourcing bio-feedstock for Eni's biorefineries as part of Eni's distinctive vertically integrated biofuel supply chain model. Joining PT ENE Indonesia means becoming part of a team that plays a crucial role in Eni's biofuel strategy while benefiting from Eni's strong market position and global integration. You will experience a truly multicultural, supportive, and dynamic work environment, with extensive learning opportunities, potential career mobility across teams and international roles, and a balanced lifestyle supported by a comprehensive benefits package, which may include health and well-being benefits.

Main responsibilities:

The Company sources residual biomass, including Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME) oil, as a bio-feedstock for biofuel production. As part of the Biomass Recovery and Valorisation team, you will:

- Conduct economic analyses to assess the potential of agricultural, industrial and forestry residues, considering costs, logistics and market dynamics.
- Identify and engage with counterparties to develop biofuel feedstock supply chains.
- Negotiate and draft supply contracts in collaboration with internal departments.
- Manage POME collection and valorisation activities, coordinating with external collectors and overseeing the Company's network to ensure efficiency and quality.
- Expand ENE's direct POME collection network by identifying new collection points, training field collectors and ensuring a reliable supply chain.
- Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, sustainability certifications and industry standards.
- Optimise POME transportation and storage in collaboration with logistics partners.
- Health, Safety and Environment (HSE): Ensuring compliance with Company HSE policies, standards and procedures, promoting a strong safety culture, reporting incidents, supporting HSE initiatives, overseeing contractor compliance, and contributing to the achievement of the Company's HSE objectives.

Skills and experience required:

- Master’s degree in Agricultural Sciences, Environmental Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field.
- Extensive experience in commercial or business development roles within the bio-feedstock sector, specifically involving Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME) oil and/or Used Cooking Oil (UCO).
- Experience managing POME and/or UCO collection programmes or similar initiatives is preferred.
- Deep understanding of waste-based bio-feedstock supply chains (e.g. POME and UCO) for energy production.
- Familiarity with waste-based bio-feedstock supply chains, including storage requirements and quality standards.
- Knowledge of sustainability certifications (e.g. ISCC) and renewable energy regulations.
- Expertise in biomass logistics and supply chain management.
- Strong analytical and negotiation skills.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- Experience training and supporting field collection teams.
- Willingness and availability to travel frequently within the region.

How to apply:

- Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
- Please upload your CV in English.

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.

Working at Eni

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

postings.description:
Job title: Legal Counsel
Location: London, UK
Job reference #: 33871
Contract type: Permanent
Language requirements: Fluent level of English

We are looking for a Legal Counsel within Liverpool Bay CCS in London, UK. You will be responsible for providing legal support across a broad range of matters related to Liverpool Bay CCS Limited (LBCCS), particularly in the areas of development of the Liverpool Bay CCS project (Project), and eventually other Eni CCS companies (the latter will be made available to relevant affiliates via intra-group service agreements, subject to regulatory requirements) – in relation to carbon capture and storage activities, projects and initiatives in the UK (CCS Activities), as well as the compliant operation of LBCCS as a regulated entity within the CCS business model (Regulated Entity Status).

About Liverpool Bay CCS Limited

Liverpool Bay CCS Ltd - part of Eni CCUS Holding Limited, the leading CCS company jointly controlled by energy-tech group Eni S.p.A. and BlackRock's GIP - is the owner and operator of the Liverpool Bay Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) Transportation and Storage (T&S) infrastructure. This project is the backbone of the HyNet Cluster, aimed at reducing carbon emissions from a wide range of industrial sectors across the North West of England and North Wales. Liverpool Bay CCS Ltd works with hard-to-abate industries to transport their captured CO₂ from various plants to safe and permanent store in depleted offshore reservoirs, beneath Liverpool Bay. The company, in addition to new facilities, is re-purposing some of its existing infrastructure, including onshore/offshore pipelines, industrial plant and offshore structures, to support economic growth in the region and help the UK path to achieve its energy transition objectives. By joining Liverpool Bay CCS Ltd, employees become part of a pioneering effort in a fast-growing CCS business, contributing to a sustainable future while benefiting from a dynamic and innovative work environment.

Main responsibilities:

- Support the legal function in providing high-quality, proactive and commercially focused legal advice and support to LBCCS, in connection with its operations, its Regulated Entity Status and all aspects of the Project, including the Economic Licence and related agreements, CCS Network Code, regulatory compliance, structuring, financing, real estate, consenting, regulators, project build (engineering, contracting etc.), partners, emitters.
- Support the legal function in providing legal advice and assistance to CCS Activities in the UK. This will include work on drafting/negotiating/amending (where appropriate with external advice and support from relevant group functions) real estate and planning agreements and documentation, commercial agreements, construction and engineering agreements (e.g. EPC), agreements with government, CO2 emitters and any other party required to enable the development of transportation and storage activities, financing, investment and divestment agreements, decommissioning security agreements, intra-group service agreements confidentiality agreements and transfer/novation agreements.
- Support the legal function in providing legal advice and assistance relating to financing and acquisition and divestiture activities related to CCS Activities in the UK and, on a case-by-case basis and, subject to LBCCS’s Regulated Entity Status, the wider group.
- Support, when necessary, activities related to financing, acquisition and divestiture, international projects & transactions, and shared legal services to affiliated business units / departments.
- Support the legal function with legal advice and assistance related to company secretarial activities of LBCCS, and subject to LBCCS’s Regulated Entity Status, the wider group.
- Support the legal function during dispute resolution including litigation, arbitration, mediation and expert determination.
Subject to LBCCS’s Regulated Entity Status, support the legal function in providing English law advice for CCS affiliates within the wider group.
- Foster internal compliance with respect to the internal policies, procedures and guidelines including matters related to HS&E, Anti-Corruption Compliance Guidelines, Law 231, Claims Reporting, Sarbanes-Oxley, etc.
- Develop, manage and operate document/information management systems to support the provision of effective legal advice to LBCCS and the Project.
- Comply fully with Eni Code of Ethics and the Compliance Model (or equivalent internal policies and procedures).

Skills and experience required:

- Degree in Law with strong academic results.
- Qualified solicitor/barrister or equivalent.
- Strong working knowledge of and relevant experience in some of the following: the UKCS upstream oil and gas industry, CCS, renewable energy development projects, and/or large infrastructure projects.
- Strong legal knowledge, particularly in the areas of CCS, commercial law, regulatory law and/or energy & environmental law.
- Good understanding of the challenges and opportunities associated with transitioning from an oil and gas industry to a low carbon future.
- Strong drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to liaise effectively with all stakeholders across the business.
- Good computer skills (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite).
- Fluent level of English. Knowledge of any other language would be a plus.

How to apply:

- Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
- Please upload your CV in English.

About Eni

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.

En Versalis, estamos buscando un Gerente de Operaciones y Ventas (Químicos para Campos Petroleros) para incorporarse a Versalis México en Villahermosa. Será el principal punto de contacto para todos los clientes de Versalis y el responsable final del negocio de químicos para campos petroleros de Versalis México, abarcando tanto el soporte operativo (puesta en marcha de plantas, pruebas de campo de nuevos productos, evaluación del rendimiento de tratamientos químicos y de subcontratistas) como las responsabilidades de ventas y desarrollo de negocio. Reportará al Gerente de la Unidad de Químicos Especiales para Campos Petroleros, quien proporcionará soporte adicional para movilizar los recursos necesarios y brindar respaldo técnico cuando sea requerido.

Acerca de Versalis

Versalis es la empresa química de Eni, con operaciones internacionales en los sectores de productos químicos básicos e intermedios, plásticos, cauchos y productos químicos de origen renovable. También está comprometida con el desarrollo de tecnologías para el reciclaje de polímeros. Como parte del compromiso de Eni con la transición energética, Versalis tiene como objetivo convertirse en una empresa química sostenible y diversificada, capaz de generar valor para todos sus grupos de interés y contribuir a la neutralidad de carbono. Con siete centros de investigación y presencia en más de 30 países, Versalis cuenta con un portafolio de aproximadamente 700 productos en los sectores químico y plástico.

Principales funciones:

- Supervisar los tratamientos químicos y los servicios/recursos asociados para los clientes de Versalis.
- Gestionar las solicitudes de servicio con subcontratistas y coordinar sus actividades, incluyendo la validación y elaboración de informes de proyecto.
- Servir como principal punto de contacto con los clientes de Versalis en la región, gestionando consultas técnicas, cuestiones relacionadas con el rendimiento de productos, cotizaciones, contratos y logística.
- Desarrollar y ejecutar un plan comercial para el territorio con el objetivo de alcanzar los objetivos anuales de ventas de las cuentas asignadas.
- Identificar oportunidades de venta adicionales con clientes existentes y captar nuevos clientes para lograr los objetivos de crecimiento del negocio, tanto en el mercado mexicano como en otras regiones.
- Participar en ferias comerciales y eventos de la industria para recopilar información sobre tendencias del mercado, competidores y precios, con el fin de proponer estrategias que favorezcan el crecimiento a largo plazo.
- Mantener contacto con todas las cuentas existentes y actualizar los registros y bases de datos de clientes y contactos.
- Brindar soporte técnico mediante la coordinación de solicitudes de pruebas de laboratorio, recopilación de muestras de proveedores, asesoramiento en I+D para nuevos productos, apoyo a Ingenieros de Campo y supervisión de la exportación de productos químicos hacia y desde México.
- Apoyar a la dirección para garantizar que todas las operaciones se gestionen de acuerdo con los requisitos de cumplimiento normativo de la empresa y la legislación aplicable.

Formación y experiencia requeridas:

- Licenciatura en Ingeniería Química o disciplina relacionada.
- Mínimo 10 años de experiencia en desarrollo de negocio dentro del sector de Exploración y Producción (Upstream) de Petróleo y Gas, específicamente en químicos para producción y procesos de tratamiento químico.
- Lido conocimiento de tratamientos químicos y de la industria petrolera en la región de Tabasco.
- Experiencia en ventas B2B y análisis estratégico de ventas.
- Dominio de SAP y de las aplicaciones de Microsoft Office.
- Nivel fluido de español e inglés (el conocimiento de italiano será valorado positivamente).
- Excelentes habilidades de negociación, con capacidad demostrada para cerrar acuerdos.
- Sólidas habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.
- Gran capacidad de organización y gestión simultánea de múltiples tareas.

Cómo postularse:

- Solo se aceptan solicitudes a través de nuestro sistema de aplicación en línea.
- Por favor, adjunte su CV en inglés.

Acerca de Eni

Eni es una empresa global de energía que opera en 61 países, con más de 30,000 empleados. Originalmente una empresa de petróleo y gas, se ha convertido en una empresa de energía integrada, desempeñando un papel clave en garantizar la seguridad energética y liderar la transición energética. El objetivo de Eni es lograr la neutralidad de carbono para 2050 mediante la descarbonización de sus procesos y de los productos que vende a sus clientes. En línea con este objetivo, Eni invierte en la investigación y el desarrollo de tecnologías que pueden acelerar la transición hacia una energía cada vez más sostenible. Las fuentes de energía renovable, la biorrefinería, la captura y almacenamiento de carbono son solo algunos ejemplos de las áreas de actividad e investigación de Eni. Además, la empresa está explorando tecnologías revolucionarias como la energía de fusión, una tecnología basada en los procesos físicos que alimentan las estrellas y que podría generar energía segura, prácticamente ilimitada y sin emisiones.

En Eni creemos en las personas emprendedoras, capaces de marcar la diferencia y de aportar su contribución con pasión e innovación, para responder a los retos globales de la transición energética. At Eni, we are seeking a Quality Control Supervisor (Bonje Agrihub) to join Eni Natural Energies Kenya EPZ Ltd. (ENEK) in Kwale. - Oversee sample collection and product testing to ensure quality compliance before receipt and storage.

- Manage communications with external laboratory service providers.
- Recommend improvements to procedures, standards, and equipment to enhance product quality.

- Ensure compliance with all procedures and systems related to Agrihub operations.
- Carry out any other duties assigned by the line manager.

Skills and experience required:

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Analytical Chemistry, Process/Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
- Fluent in English.
- Relevant QA/QC experience, preferably in a vegetable oil extraction plant or similar manufacturing environment.
- Knowledge of laboratory techniques, equipment, and quality systems.
- Basic Firefighting and HSE training (preferred).
- Project management experience.

Required Competencies

- QA/QC systems, ISO standards, and TQM.
- Commissioning, start-up, and decommissioning activities.
- Mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical maintenance.

- Process improvement and site management.
- Strong computer and analytical skills.

- Entrepreneurial mindset.

About the Zubair Field Operating Division

Working at the Zubair Field Operating Division within Eni Iraq B.V. presents an exceptional opportunity to join a dynamic, forward-thinking team at the forefront of energy innovation. Located in the strategic Basra region, the Zubair oil and gas field stands as a critical asset within Eni’s global portfolio, playing a vital role in the exploration, production, and development of hydrocarbons and natural gas. As a member of our team, you will be involved in ground-breaking projects that not only enhance energy production but also pave the way for sustainable energy solutions. Our efforts go beyond just energy production, we actively support local communities through various initiatives in education, healthcare, and environmental sustainability. By joining us, you will help drive the future of energy while making a tangible, positive impact on the lives of people in Iraq. Together, we will work towards sustainable progress and energy solutions that benefit both local and global communities.

Main responsibilities

At Eni, we are looking for a Senior Agronomist within Eni Natural Energies S.p.A. in Kigali, Rwanda.

About Eni Natural Energies SpA – Rwanda Branch

Eni Natural Energies SpA (ENE) is an integrated energy company with headquarters in Milan, Italy. Its subsidiary, Eni Natural Energies SpA - Rwanda Branch (ENE Rwanda), operates in Rwanda on two main streams of activities: Agri-Business and Carbon Offset.

Regarding the Agri-Business, with its seeds multiplication project, ENE Rwanda multiplies seeds of oil crops for export to other ENE geographies in collaboration with the National Industrial Research and Development Agency (NIRDA) and Rwandan operating companies. The overall objectives are to increase the quantity and quality of the produced seeds, share ENE's knowledge on oil crops built over previous years and in different African countries, and apply the latest technologies to this agricultural sector. So far, more than 135 tons of castor seeds have been produced and processed in the country over three planting seasons (from September 2023 until March 2025), and the fourth season is starting with a significant scale-up in terms of involved area and investments.

The ENE Rwanda Clean Cooking Program is the main company Carbon Offset activity currently ongoing in the country, supporting corporate decarbonization targets. The program aims to distribute up to 500,000 improved cookstoves (ICS) across the country, mainly locally manufactured, to provide direct positive benefits to the involved communities—especially regarding health, reducing pressures on Rwandan forests, enhancing local manufacturing, and creating job opportunities. As of now, more than 10,000 ICS have been distributed in Nyagatare District with the Rwandan NGO Rwanda Women’s Network (RWN), and a new project will kick off before the end of the year.

Main responsibilities:

- Seed production and management, including seed quality management.

- Selecting suitable crop varieties based on climate and soil conditions.

- Soil management: assessing soil quality and recommending appropriate land preparation techniques.

- Monitoring crop performance and identifying potential risks.

- Implementing sustainable farming techniques, such as crop rotation and integrated pest management.

- Research and innovation: conducting field trials and experiments to improve oil crop yields.

- Training and capacity building: providing technical training to farmers, field officers and project staff regarding oil crops and good agricultural practices.

- Project implementation and monitoring: supervising field operations to ensure compliance with project goals.

- Sustainability and compliance: ensuring that farming practices align with environmental and regulatory standards.

- Stakeholder engagement: collaborating with local operating companies and government agencies; coordinating with relevant authorities for agriculture, import-export of seeds, and seed certification/quality assurance, as well as research institutions and agricultural organizations.

Skills and experience required:

- Master's degree in Agricultural Sciences, with a preference for specializations in Tropical Agronomy, Environment and Bioenergy. Qualifications other than those indicated may also be evaluated based on significant experience relevant to the role.

- Extensive experience in agro-industrial supply chains or farm management, preferably aimed at the energy sectors. Previous experience in Africa or the bioenergy sector is considered a plus.

- Knowledge of aggregation systems in agriculture with small and large-scale farmers, supply chain management, preparation and organization of sowing campaigns and post-harvest activities.

- Knowledge of cultivation systems to produce oil crops for bio feedstock, with reference to rotation crops and crops suitable for cultivation in degraded areas not suited to food production.

- Knowledge of seed production and management, including seed quality management.

- Knowledge of agricultural regulations and, if possible, reference to renewable energy from biomass, biofuels, certifications and general environmental and social sustainability criteria.

- Ability to work in a team and coordinate other people.

- Willingness to travel in or out of the country for field missions.

- Ability to relate to public entities.

- Proficient in English. Knowledge of Kinyarwanda and/or French is a plus.

- Knowledge of agricultural digital solutions, tracking and mapping systems (GIS, Google Earth, etc.) is a plus.

- Experience in agricultural research trials.

- Consolidated experience in managing all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) aspects associated with core agricultural activities under own supervision.

At Eni, we are looking for a Senior Market Risk Analyst (Products) to join Eni Trade & Biofuels (ETB) in London, UK. You will be responsible for providing daily performance and market risk analysis for the oil trading business in London, working closely with traders and other teams across ETB.

En Eni, estamos buscando un Senior Marketing Specialist para unirse a Enilive Iberia en Madrid. Serás responsable de gestionar y desarrollar las actividades de Marketing de Enilive Iberia, con un enfoque principal en el mercado español, dando soporte a los negocios de Red de Estaciones de Servicio y Lubricantes, de acuerdo con la estrategia y las directrices corporativas del Grupo. El ámbito de actuación también incluye la sucursal de Portugal, especialmente en iniciativas transversales o relacionadas con el negocio de Lubricantes. Además, liderarás la adaptación de las políticas y campañas corporativas al mercado local, identificando y promoviendo iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento del negocio, refuercen el posicionamiento de la marca y mejoren la experiencia y fidelización de los clientes.

Acerca de Enilive Iberia S.L.U.

Enilive Iberia forma parte de Enilive, la compañía de Eni dedicada a los productos y servicios para la movilidad. En España desarrollamos nuestra actividad principalmente en tres áreas de negocio: la red de estaciones de servicio, la comercialización de carburantes y combustibles y el negocio de lubricantes, que cuenta además con una planta de producción en Gavà (Barcelona) y actividad comercial en España y Portugal.
Enilive Iberia combina las oportunidades y la proyección de un grupo internacional con una forma de trabajar cercana, dinámica y colaborativa. Estamos en un momento de crecimiento y transformación que ofrece la oportunidad de participar directamente en proyectos relevantes para el negocio, trabajar de forma transversal con diferentes áreas y tener una visión amplia de la compañía. Buscamos personas con iniciativa, que quieran aportar ideas, asumir responsabilidades y ver cómo su trabajo se traduce en resultados concretos.

Principales funciones

- Coordinar y ejecutar el plan de Marketing junto con los responsables y equipos comerciales y de negocio, identificando necesidades y oportunidades en el mercado local.
- Adaptar e implantar políticas, campañas, contenidos y materiales corporativos, garantizando la alineación con el área corporativa de Marketing y Branding y con la identidad de Enilive Iberia.
- Diseñar y coordinar campañas promocionales, lanzamientos de productos y servicios, acciones comerciales y programas de fidelización.
- Gestionar y desarrollar la web, la app, los canales digitales, los materiales comerciales y la comunicación en los puntos de venta.
- Proponer iniciativas de conocimiento, segmentación y fidelización de clientes que mejoren su experiencia y refuercen su vínculo con la marca.
- Colaborar con los equipos comerciales en el desarrollo de materiales, promociones y acciones orientadas al cumplimiento de sus objetivos, así como coordinar eventos, ferias y actividades con clientes y distribuidores.
- Coordinar agencias, proveedores y colaboradores externos, realizando el seguimiento de los proyectos y servicios contratados.
- Participar en la elaboración y seguimiento del presupuesto de Marketing, analizando los indicadores y resultados de las acciones desarrolladas.

Formación y experiencia requeridas

- Titulación universitaria en Marketing, Administración y Dirección de Empresas (ADE), Comunicación, Publicidad o disciplinas afines.
- Nivel alto de inglés. Se valorará el conocimiento de italiano.
- Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Marketing, gestionando campañas, proyectos y canales, así como coordinando agencias y proveedores.
- Se valorará experiencia en compañías internacionales y en sectores B2C y/o B2B, retail, movilidad, automoción, energía, gran consumo o similares.
- Conocimientos de Marketing digital, herramientas de análisis y medición de resultados.
- Capacidad para comprender las necesidades comerciales y transformarlas en iniciativas de Marketing efectivas.
- Buen manejo de herramientas digitales, de análisis y de presentación de información.
